acquisition_rule: Acquire only through the authority page's model link; record final URL, retrieval UTC, byte count, and SHA-256. Any redirect to an unversioned or changed model is HOLD, not substitution.

system.target: the authority model's hungry/eat labels evaluated separately; no target may be rewritten after enumeration
observation_maps: O_orbit: lexicographically minimal cyclic rotation of (p1,p2,p3)
system.admissible_actions: Enabled guarded-command/scheduler choices already present in the parsed model; no new action subset may be invented.
system.representation: gamma(p1,p2,p3)=(p2,p3,p1) with the corresponding module/command relabeling

frozen_checks: parse and enumerate all reachable states and probabilistic transitions
prove gamma closure and bijection over the reachable domain
compare every successor distribution after state/action relabeling
compute observation-fiber target constancy for O_exact, O_orbit, and O_event
compute reachability support under all existing enabled choices and any domain-native command class only if the source names that class
emit the first mismatch under lexicographic (state,action,successor) order
positive_prediction: Exact cyclic representation transport commutes and permits solved-origin reuse for cyclic-invariant targets.
negative_controls: process-1-specific target label must break cyclic target preservation
deleting one relabeled enabled command must break action-family closure
kill_criteria: any domain or target closure residue for the positive target
required action classes cannot be recovered without investigator invention
retry_rule: No repair or alternate N after a failure. Localize and return HOLD.
